name: Verdalux
tagline: The operating system for indoor agriculture at industrial scale.
positioning: Verdalux unifies climate, irrigation, and yield telemetry across every growth tower so enterprise farms run like precision manufacturing lines.

hero.h1: Grow like a factory. Yield like a farm.
hero.sub: Verdalux turns every vertical growth tower into a governed, measurable production line — from seedling to shipment — with one control plane your entire operation trusts.

features.title: Unified climate control
features.description: Orchestrate temperature, humidity, CO2, and airflow across thousands of racks from a single recipe engine — no more per-room spreadsheets.

features.title: Yield telemetry
features.description: Track grams-per-watt and harvest variance by tower, tray, and cultivar in real time. Every anomaly traced to a root cause.

features.title: Irrigation governance
features.description: Nutrient dosing and water reuse loops enforced by policy, logged for audit, and tuned automatically against target EC and pH.

features.title: Predictive interventions
features.description: Verdalux flags a failing pump or drifting canopy before yield drops, routing a work order to the right technician's queue.

features.title: Compliance by default
features.description: Generate GAP and food-safety records automatically. Every batch carries an immutable trace from seed lot to pallet.

features.title: Multi-site scale
features.description: Roll out standardized grow recipes across facilities on three continents and compare performance site by site.

testimonials.quote: We consolidated four disconnected control systems into Verdalux in a quarter. Our grams-per-watt is up 19% and I finally trust a single number for yield.
testimonials.name: Marta Feldkamp

testimonials.quote: The audit trail alone paid for the platform. What used to be a two-week records scramble before certification is now a report I export in minutes.
testimonials.name: Dev Ramanathan

testimonials.quote: Verdalux gave us a common operating language across seven facilities. Our best-performing site's recipe is now everyone's baseline.
testimonials.name: Clara Ostberg
